title: Geodesy
description: Measure one baseline and two angles and every other distance follows - that is how countries were mapped, triangle by triangle. Geodesy measures the planet itself. Unlocks the Theodolite Lens, the Geoid Model and the Geodetic Surveyor.

puzzle.goal: Surveyors measure one side c of a triangle and the angles at both its ends; the third angle γ follows. Write the length a of the side opposite the angle α.
puzzle.name: Triangulation by the sine rule
puzzle.ask: Find a in metres for a @{c} m baseline c, α = @{α} rad and γ = 1.2 rad.
puzzle.method: Drop a height from one corner onto the opposite side: it equals each adjacent side times the sine of its angle, so a sin γ = c sin α.
